verdict.rationale: The docs show a general-purpose coding agent. Agent mode edits workspace files and validates them, the cloud agent works independently in the background like a human developer, you can mention @copilot on a pull request to request changes, and automations can run the agent on a schedule or on repository events. That implies these chores can be delegated, but none of the four named tasks is documented specifically. missing for 10: explicit documentation of test generation, lint-error fixing, merge-conflict resolution and dependency updates, plus hands-on or independent corroboration of any of these tasks.
